clips.label: Golden hook
clips.vo: What if your AI agent could direct a whole film, starring a stick figure?
clips.visual: A clapperboard drops onto an empty stage; a stick figure pops in under a spotlight and reacts with surprise.

clips.label: Disrupt
clips.vo: Normally, that means stock footage, a timeline editor, and a weekend lost to keyframes.
clips.visual: Documents and clocks rain down and pile up around the figure; labels for stock footage, timeline and weekend appear; a red cross stamps the pile.

clips.label: Secret
clips.vo: Stickman Kino flips it. You write the story. Your agent writes every scene as code.
clips.visual: The figure types at a desk; a flow of story, code and film builds while lines of code type out.

clips.label: Truth
clips.vo: Fifty poses. Nearly two hundred props. Charts, captions, camera moves, and a real voice.
clips.visual: The figure sprints down a road while a checklist of features pops in beside it.

clips.label: Theme switch 1
clips.vo: Change the theme, the format, or the script, and the whole film re-renders.

clips.label: Elevation
clips.vo: Stickman Kino. Clone it, ask your agent, and ship the film. So, what will your stick figure explain first?
clips.visual: Logo and wordmark lock up; the figure celebrates with confetti, then lifts a big question mark.
